recognize_zh: 單顆大型細胞的細胞質塞滿緻密的深紫紅色粗顆粒，顆粒佈滿整個細胞並遮蓋細胞核輪廓，看不到核仁或核旁淡染區；這種「顆粒遮核」的外觀是 APL 高顆粒性異常前骨髓細胞的教科書例子。
features: Single large cell, roughly twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm completely packed with dense, coarse purple-red azurophilic granules
Granules overlie and obscure the nucleus, whose outline is barely discernible
No visible nucleolus, perinuclear hof or Golgi zone
Auer rods not clearly identified in this cell
Background of normocytic red cells without other leukocytes
describe_en: High-power view of the peripheral blood shows a large cell whose cytoplasm is packed with dense, coarse azurophilic granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus. No perinuclear hof or nucleolus is visible, and Auer rods are not clearly seen in this cell. The surrounding red cells are normocytic. Findings are consistent with a hypergranular abnormal promyelocyte of acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA.

ddx.vs: A basophil is smaller, has a segmented nucleus and dark purple-black granules that often wash out, rather than dense red-purple azurophilic granules.
Normal promyelocytes are confined to the marrow and show a visible round nucleus with a nucleolus and a clear perinuclear Golgi zone.
Mast cells have a round, centrally placed nucleus and metachromatic granules; they are tryptase and CD117 positive and CD34/MPO negative.
Toxic neutrophils have a clearly visible segmented nucleus with dark granules in a pale cytoplasm.
